notes.title: Patch Notes for 6/7/2023
notes.notes:
[b]PC/Windows[/b]
●    Various font display bugs corrected
●    Fixed various issues that would occur when saving/loading at very start of the game
●    Corrected visual differences between poems in game and poems in gallery
●    Fixed an issue where notifications for newly unlocked side stories would not appear correctly

[b]Mac[/b]
●    Various small visual bugs corrected
●    Various font display bugs corrected
●    Fixed various issues that would occur when saving/loading at very start of the game
●    Fixed an issue in which certain lines of dialogue would not display correctly in the History Tab
●    Fixed an issue where English phrases would appear when playing in Japanese
●    Fixed an issue where certain menu buttons would play sounds while hidden in the Quick Menu
●    Fixed an issue where text in the credits would overlap in some circumstances
●    Corrected visual differences between poems in game and poems in gallery
●    Added an “Apply” button for use when changing screen resolutions in settings
●    Fixed an issue where changing scenes would cause visual bugs under some screen resolutions
●    Fixed an issue where notifications for newly unlocked side stories would not appear correctly

notes.title: Patch Notes for 6/22/2022
notes.notes:
These patch notes are for the Windows version of DDLC Plus. Updates for Mac and console versions are on their way and will be available soon. 
[list]
[*] Various special effects in Act 2 and Act 3 were adjusted to be more accurate to the original game
[*] Fixed an issue where Natsuki's portrait would unintentionally flicker for a frame during her first CG in Act 2
[*] Fixed an issue where in-game music loops and transitions were not handled correctly
[*] Added a confirmation button for changing display settings
[*] Fixed the vertical alignment of text in dialogue boxes for some languages
[*] Support added to player name input for Steamdeck and Big Picture Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 8/2/2021
notes.notes:
- Fixed a save-related bug that could prevent progression after the end of Act 1
- Fixed a game-freeze that could occur when exiting to main menu during an Act 2 choice
- Fixed a camera zoom bug when changing aspect ratio from 16:9 to 16:10
- Fixed a file-related bug that could prevent the player from progressing past Act 3
- Fixed a memory leak that could cause a potential crash in the Act 2 weekend scene
- Fixed a bug with DDLC credits music cutting out too soon
- Using F12 to take a screenshot no longer re-shows UI
- Fixed some UI problems on ultrawide resolutions
- Fixed some problems that could occur when naming the main character "Monika"

notes.title: Update Notes for 7/22/2021
notes.notes:
- Added a "Dialogue Box Size" option in DDLC settings menu for easier readability
- Fixed a bug that could prevent the player from progressing past Act 3
- Fixed a bug with music looping at the start of Act 2
- Fixed a bug where the incorrect .chr files would display under certain conditions
- Fixed a bug that could cause side story completion to not save in certain situations
- Fixed a bug with multiple Natsuki poem unlocks happening at once
- Fixed a save/load bug during Yuri's "Haah" scene
- Fixed conditional triggers for 'New Game' achievement
- Revised behavior of the 'weekend help' choice during Act 2 when specifically using keyboard or controller
- Fixed a few English typos

notes.title: Update Notes for 7/16/2021
notes.notes:
- Fixed an additional problem with special poem unlock conditions
- Fixed a bug where players who automatically reached 100% completion due to the removal of the Yuri choice unlock requirement wouldn't receive the TestVM
- Fixed a save/load bug during a Natsuki glitched eyes sequence
- Fixed two strings in TestVM that were not correctly localizing in other languages

notes.title: Update Notes for 7/15/2021
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with Steam cloud saves that could cause progress to be lost
- Fixed a bug where special poems may show up in English when language is Latin American Spanish
- Fixed a bug that could cause a softlock when saving into a save slot
- Fixed "Stories of Friendship and Literature" not displaying in the Jukebox when unlocked
- Improved procedure for special poem unlocks to randomize the chosen poems upon choosing New Game and prevent duplicates from being shown
- Fixed a bug that that could cause content warnings setting to revert to an old setting when choosing New Game
- Added more supported resolutions for non-16:9 aspect ratios
- Fixed some audio sync issues during the Act 2 fight between Natsuki and Yuri
- Fixed a bug that caused save slot time codes to display as GMT after quitting and reloading the game
- Removed the requirement for 100% completion that required choosing "Yes" for Yuri at the end of Act 2


Thank you to everyone who has submitted bug reports thus far! We are aware of additional issues not addressed in this patch, and our team is still investigating and fixing them. Please continue to submit tickets via our [url=https://airtable.com/shrd4lEcAncgFuyoh]Bug Submission Form[/url]

Additional notes:
- Some users have reported issues with their mouse/controller setup that causes left or down inputs to constantly be registered. We are still looking into this issue. If submitting a ticket about this item, please include as much info as you can about what USB devices you have plugged in and what type of controller you're using.
- We have seen a few reports of crashes or errors when starting the application. Some of these issues may be hardware or environment specific, but we are still investigating to look for potential fixes. Please provide a .zip folder with logs in your report whenever possible, as explained in the bug submission form. Additionally, if possible, please include the following information about your setup: operating system (ex: Windows 10), RAM (ex: 16.0 GB), and CPU/Processor
